certification.name: Attacking and Securing CI/CD Pipeline Certification
certification.description: Covers CI/CD pipeline exploitation, secret and credential abuse, artifact poisoning, OIDC and cloud identity abuse, container registry and Kubernetes delivery attacks, and pipeline hardening. Assessed by a 48-hour practical exam in a lab followed by 48 hours to submit a report.
certification.currency_note: Course with lifetime access and one exam voucher that does not expire; page shows 'starting at' USD 700
